title: Selector and retention pair laws
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n\ge 0$, and let $\theta\in[-1,1]$. The law of two $\Omega^n$-valued sequences obtained by independently sampling coordinatewise value pairs from $\pi$ and selecting between each pair using correlated uniform signs of correlation $\theta$ equals the retention-and-resampling pair law with retention parameter $(1+\theta)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
